en: Err... Hello, sir- uh madam. Ahem... How can I help you?
Hello, dearie~ You wouldn't happen to have seen a few suspicious individuals around here, would you~?
When I hear Pyra's voice, I glance over at Jewel. Her eyes are wide and her body is shaking. She returns my gaze with a fearful look.
Pfft. I'd have known if someone walked into my bar.
Oh, you would~? Well that's very comforting~
I wrap an arm around Jewel, holding her close and rubbing her arm lightly. She leans into me and I can feel the shaking slow down a bit.
You see~ The last time I visited this... 'lovely' establishment, I had a nice visit with your prized little dancer~ Cute girl~
I give Jewel a reassuring squeeze, silently letting her know that Pyra's gonna have to get through me before she can get to her again.
She told me that you've been interacting with these sweet little miscreants quite a lot~ It's almost like you're friends with the little band of traitors~
There's a creak on the bar above us as Pyra leans forward on it, causing Jewel to hide her face against my shoulder. I can feel tears dampening my skin.
Where are they, Martin~?
W-Well erm...
I can see it in your eyes~ You know~
I nod to the others to get ready to fight.
Okay! I'll tell you! They said they were heading about a day's walk up north. Something about a camp or something like that.
There's an air of silent confusion in our hidden group. He was lying for us. I shake my head for the others to stand down and give Jewel a squeeze.
You wouldn't be lying to me, would you~?
Of course not, madam.
That's good~ Because if you were lying~ Well that would be very very bad for you~ Would you like to know why~?
I. Fucking. Hate. Liars.
So if I go up north to this nice little camp of theirs and there's nothing there~?
Well~ I'll tear that cute little face clean off your skull~
So~ They still up north~?
They're still north.
Whole day's walk, hm~?
Yes madam. That's what they said.
Mmhm~ Good boy~
Once Pyra's gone, we peek our heads out from under the bar.
Hey err... Thanks, blue.
Anytime. We're in this together. I've got your back.
Heh... Yeah.
Fuck, fuck, fuck.
Hey... Thank you.
I'm fucking dead.
No, you're not. Listen. We need to do this plan now before she gets back.
No... We need to get things ready first. Did you find those lights?
There weren't any lights back there.
Fuck... Alright, err... Recently I've been having thefts of inventory.
Thefts?
Ever since things got worse around here... I've been losing supplies and food...
The Lumber Rats. They're probably stealing those supplies.
Let's go pay ol' Lumber Rat Ray a visit then.
Just hurry please...
These things are all smashed...
Jeez...
Easy smash. Rida show.
I don't think we need another demonstration.
You alright, Jewel?
Just... Let's just keep moving.
... Well... We're gonna need replacements of some kind... Maybe Martin has some spares laying around?
Let's go ask him.
Martin! We need to talk to you abou-
Let me just... stop you right there.
Huh?
Look... This place wasn't all that great to begin with, but now with all the shit going on outside? I don't want to get involved in whatever plans you've got.
Right...
Martin. Listen to her.
Jewel! Oh my god, are you okay? I thought that they... I thought I wouldn't see you again.
I'm fine, Martin. Really.
Well... I'm glad... but I really can't risk what little I've got left for-
You remember that dream you kept telling me about, Martin? How you wanted to-
-run a real restaurant... I remember.
Well this place isn't really what you had in mind, is it?
... You know it isn't, Jewel. I'm just sitting here serving rations and watered down 'beer'. The only reason people come here is for you... You know that.
Well... What if we changed that?
... I... We can't, Jewel. We have to give the people what they want. No one wants real food these days, it's just sex, sex, sex...
Listen... This isn't living. If we all band together, we can change this. You can finally live your dream. We just need to put on the biggest show yet.
W-... Then what?
When we've got everyone's attention, we show them all that they can fight for their dreams. If we all band together with the resistance, we can push-
The what!? Keep your voice down! Christ!
... It's either that or keep living like this.
Ugh... Dammit. Listen. The place was trashed when those... people came for Jewel. The stage lights aren't working from here. Go check them out.
So you'll do it?
... I'll think about it... You're lucky I don't just call the guards on you... I wouldn't do that to Jewel.
Thanks, Martin.
Mhm... Go check the lights.
Martin. Looks like those lights are definitely smashed up. We couldn't do much up there without any replacements.
Ugh... Well... Maybe try looking in the back room? I think we've got some replacement lights back there.
I'll keep watch out here.
Sounds good. Let's get back there.
She's breathing heavily with a smile on her face as the song comes to a close. After a moment of silence, the crowd suddenly erupts into applause.
Woo!
Yeah, Jewel!
Listen up, everyone! That tower that the GAG is building? It's going to fry our brains and take away what little we've got left.
So we all gotta band together and fight while we still can. They can be defeated. We can kick them out of OUR town!
My dream is to keep singing and dancing. To live my life on my own terms. Not for anyone else...
She looks over at me and smiles.
But for me.
I'm gonna fight for that dream, and I'm willing to bet that you're all gonna fight for yours as well. So come join the resistance and fight!
Errr...
I dunno...
I'll be staying with them~ Singing and dancing to my heart's content~
... For the resistance!
We're with you, Jewel!
The crowd starts erupting into cheers once more, all voicing their support and approval of the jewel shining up on stage. She glances over at me and winks.
Let's go show Lady our new friends.
I'm so proud!!
Hah! That'll teach you guys to try and crash someone's party!
There's gonna be more of them, we gotta stay on our toes.
More fight! Rida want more!
Don't worry, Rida. Seems like that's exactly what we'll be getting.
If we can hold this entrance, they won't be able to funnel in.
Jenna...
Hmm?
Look!
It's Jewel! She's back!
Hey everyone...
We missed you!
And we missed that booty too!
Heh, missed you guys too. We're uh...
She looks over at me as if looking for support. I give her a reassuring nod.
We're gonna do something a little different tonight.
Aww!
This song is dedicated to my mom, Ela Patel.
She's gonna do it! Wooo! Go Jewel!
What dancer girl do?
You'll see.
Jenna, we've got company.
There they are! Get them!
Anyone getting deja vu?
DJ, hit it!
We've got the supplies, Martin.
Excellent! I'll start getting everything ready!
I'll... go get ready, I guess.
I'll keep you company!
Thanks, blue.
I'll get the lights fixed.
Rida go with dancer girl!
Uhhh... How about you help with the lights, Rida?
That sounds like a great idea, Throb! Come on, Rida. Let's help out.
Hmph...
Thanks, guys.
Blue?
Hm?
Do you think you can take my spot?
Wh- You mean like dance on stage instead of you?
I'm just... Not feeling up to it...
What do you mean? You love dancing!
I know.
The plan is to have you dance so we can recruit everyone...
I know...
I'm probably gonna regret this... Just like I regret telling that bitch where everyone was... Just like I regret not siding with my... mom... before she...
I'm sorry, blue... I don't know what's wrong with me... It should be so easy to go out there, but it's just... It's just not...
Everyone's counting on me, and I'm letting them down...
What if you sang?
I- Wha?
I saw you eyeing up a microphone in the back room of the bar when we were looking for the lights. Figured you were thinking of singing.
Caught that, huh? You're observant...
So do you like singing?
Yeah, maybe a little.
So why not sing for everyone?
Because that's not what everyone wants.
W- Huh? You don't know that.
Of course I do. They just want to see me get up on stage and shake my ass with my tits out.
That's all they want from me...
Isn't that what you want too? I thought you enjoyed it.
Yes... but... It's just... I don't know.
It's not working like it used to. Like my brain's disconnected from my body. Just doesn't want to work anymore.
Seems like it's still connected to your lips though.
... Thanks...?
So sing.
Blue...
Don't think about what they want. Think about what you want.
They love you. They'll be happy to see you perform no matter what you do, because it's you, and you're amazing. I know I'll be rooting for you.
I don't know what to say, blue...
Say yes, of course.
I don't want to do something I'll regret...
You'll regret not doing it. The Jewel I know doesn't care what people think.
What if I'm not the Jewel you know anymore?
You are. I'm sure of it. That star is still there.
Jenna! Guards are coming! Need your help!
Crap!
Just gonna leave this here. I'm rooting for you. You've got this.
Fuck...
Just in time. Thought you were gonna miss the party.
Never. I'm the life of the party.
Party's over! You're all violating gathering laws! Clear the building now or you will be punished!
I'll take care of this.
Who do you guys think you are, the party police?
... Yes?
Tough luck! We're not going anywhere!
Then we're going to kick your ass and drag all of you out.
Hah! You and what army?
You'll see. Last warning.
We really need to work on your diplomacy skills.
Rida think Carcen did good diplo- dipl- talk!
We're fucked...
Err... I'm n-not so sure about this.
The guards are b-blocking the only exit!
This isn't working. How's our secret weapon doing?
Errr... She's doing... She's definitely doing, that's for sure.
Shit... Everyone's gonna turn and run the moment they can. We can't do this without her.
First things first, we gotta take these guards on before they hurt someone.
Time to kick some ass.
Wh- What is this?
We found a few recruits for you, Lady.
A few? It's like you dragged the whole town down here!
All thanks to Jewel.
I had backup.
I guess it was a team effort.
I see... Well... This is good. Good job. We'll see to it that these recruits are welcomed and put to good use.
Awesome.
Place ain' bad, ol' Ray an' th' boys (an' girls) migh' like it 'ere.
What are they doing here?
Err... They helped!
Tha's righ' wee lass, ol Ray an' th' boys (an' girls) ain' gonna sit 'round an' let 'em fuckers up in th' tower take our dreams away.
And we're supposed to just take you thugs in because you suddenly just decide to be good?
Lady... We need all the help we can get...
Fine. They can stay. They make their own corner though.
Aye. Come on then boys (an' girls), let's make our new home away from home.
Hey blue?
Yeah?
... Thank you.
Don't mention it! Did you enjoy yourself?
It was wonderful, blue! Did ya hear me up there? I nailed it!
I heard the whole thing!
I couldn't have done it without you, blue.
Nah, you had it in you the whole time. It was all you.
Thanks, hun.
So how are you feeling now?
... Fulfilled.
That sounds good! I'm glad you're doing better! Even if you weren't, I'd have your back no matter what.
Thanks, hun.
Ya know, I may have to give you a little something something as 'thanks'.
Oh! Yep, you're definitely back to your old self again.
Heheh! I feel better than my old self.
I'm so proud!
You're adorable. I'm gonna head over to that little bar area in the mansion. Wanna come with?
Sounds like a good time!
Damn right.
(Been a few days now. I think the Lumber Rats and the Carcens have completed their new parts of the camp.)
(Still can't believe we've got them on our side now. If we can get them on our side, I'm sure Rida's old tribe will help too. I should talk to her.)
